508:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

508:t_1:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...I'm disappointed in this planet's agent.」

508:t_1:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's just the shallow cunning of an Earthling. I even lent them a bearer of high-concentration spirit quanta, and they can't produce any decent results.」

508:t_1:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Or should we consider $c to be the special ones?」

508:t_1:8.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That is the more reasonable view.」

508:t_1:9.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「The fact that people who reached this level were left unattended is more important.」

508:t_1:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Considering the jurisdiction over this universe, it can't be helped. On top of that, they even used something like a dimensional cage.」

508:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

508:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It's still none of your concern.」

508:t_1:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty the Emperor. So basically, until I steal the $$いがみ合う双子$$, I'm treated as half-baked.」

508:t_1:14.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing more to say.」

508:t_1:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Stay out of it, $$アムブリエル$$. They're my prey.」

508:t_1:17.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm stuck minding the house?」

508:t_1:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll dispose of your cute $n while I'm at it.」

508:t_1:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't worry, I'll bring back that $$ジェミニオン$$ thing too. You can use it and become the Reactor of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

508:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So you do acknowledge my power, to a degree.」

508:t_1:21.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get cocky. It isn't me who decides whether you truly deserve to call yourself $$アムブリエル$$.」

508:t_1:22.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...I'm grateful you dragged me out into the open, but I can't see us having a good time together, you and me.」

508:t_1:23.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Heh... An interesting woman.」

508:t_1:24.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If she didn't have the factor, I'd kill her right now.」

508:t_1:25.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If she lacked even that much spirit, she would have no right to sit in this seat.」

508:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「In that sense, all of $c's Reactors also have the power to deserve it. The $$いがみ合う双子$$ included.」

508:t_1:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So you're saying they're approaching the Third Stage.」

508:t_1:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Still, I never thought we'd find two humans who could awaken the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

508:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It must be because of the peculiarity of this planet called Earth.」

508:t_1:31.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers here...? Or is it precisely because it is like this that the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers...」

508:t_1:32.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And the power that the people of this planet hold is gradually starting to take shape...」

508:t_1:33.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Echoing the movements of $c in each region, cracks are appearing in the front lines. If this continues, the wind may change direction.」

508:t_1:34.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then I'll go cut off the root of it.」

508:t_1:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$... This should get interesting.」

508:t_1:36.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... Do you not want to acknowledge your own roots?」

508:t_1:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...$$グエン$$ is an agent of $$クロノ$$...」

508:t_1:43.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$... He asked me to give you his regards.」

508:t_1:44.en:
$$オットー$$
「Who is this $$グエン$$ man?」

508:t_1:45.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He's someone who looked after me in the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

508:t_1:46.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He's the heir of a powerful local family, and quite an ambitious man.」

508:t_1:47.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He's sharp, too, and he was in charge of negotiating with the $$ムーンレィス$$ who had begun descending to Earth, but...」

508:t_1:48.en:
$$ブライト$$
「He tried to use the connections he made there and the legacy of past civilizations for his own ambitions, and in the end he came into conflict with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$.」

508:t_1:49.en:
$$ロラン$$
「After we parted ways with $$万丈$$ and $$ロジャー$$ during the fight against the 《$$エグゼクター$$》, his whereabouts were unknown, but to think he had become a member of $$クロノ$$...」

508:t_1:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You could say that's just like him, and leave it at that.」

508:t_1:51.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「He called himself a newcomer, so he is probably not from a clan bound to $$クロノ$$, like the $$マーセナス家$$.」

508:t_1:52.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$グエン$$... What on earth are you thinking...)

508:t_1:53.en:
$$オットー$$
「Colonel $$ブライト$$... What about pursuing Congressman $$ローナン・マーセナス$$?」

508:t_1:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It would end in wasted effort. He's too big a target to move against on the word of Ensign $$リディ$$ alone.」

508:t_1:55.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we go about it clumsily, the half-ruined $$地球連邦$$ government will collapse completely from paranoia.」

508:t_1:56.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In the end, the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives are a subordinate organization of the $$サイデリアル$$. If we win the war against the Empire, their existence will lose its meaning.」

508:t_1:57.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「So what we should think about now is ending the war against the Empire as quickly as possible.」

508:t_1:58.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Vice Minister $$ドーリアン$$... After you were captured by the Empire in $$オーブ$$, were you in $$ラース・バビロン$$?」

508:t_1:59.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Yes... Besides us, there were people gathered from all over the world there.」

508:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Most likely to be used for the spirit quanta absorption system we heard about earlier.」

508:t_1:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you saying they went to the trouble of using a Vice Minister, Princess $$マリナ$$, and Representative $$アスハ$$ for that?」

508:t_1:62.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's tactless of me to say this, but I think they could have put you to more effective use, like this hostage operation...」

508:t_1:63.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「That would be because we were the kind of people they wanted... because we held a large amount of whatever 'spirit quanta' is.」

508:t_1:64.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ seemed to have no interest in our titles or positions, and only to want strong people... people with a lot of spirit quanta.」

508:t_1:66.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Nothing I said reached him, though...」

508:t_1:67.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, Vice Minister... I'm glad we were able to welcome you back like this.」

508:t_1:68.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We are about to move out to check $$ネオ・ジオン$$, so we will show the Vice Minister to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

508:t_1:69.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Understood. I will help Lady $$ミネバ$$ there as well.」

508:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll be departing right away, but if you like, please spend the time until then with $$ヒイロ$$.」

508:t_1:71.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Thank you for your consideration.」

508:t_1:72.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「But he has already given me plenty of strength. I would only be in the way of your departure, so I will just see you off.」

508:t_1:74.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Please tell everyone that Princess $$マリナ$$, $$ナナリー$$, and Representative $$アスハ$$ are all safe.」

508:t_1:75.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. We will get ready as quickly as possible and rescue the people captured in $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

508:t_1:80.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...I heard, $$ロラン$$. About the young master.」

508:t_1:82.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Well... I can't put it into words very well, but... don't take it too hard.」

508:t_1:83.en:
$$シン$$
「As for me, I was almost impressed, like, 'He'd really go that far...?'」

508:t_1:85.en:
$$シン$$
「W-what!? I was just trying to cheer $$ロラン$$ up...」

508:t_1:86.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Even so, choose your words a little better! You're always so lacking in delicacy, $$シン$$!」

508:t_1:87.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Thank you, $$ルナマリア$$. But I'm all right.」

508:t_1:88.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...Actually, I was thinking the same kind of thing as $$シン$$.」
